confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for food and drink prices. There is no Tottori-specific Numbeo data. Restaurant anchors use Japan Numbeo figures for Tokyo (1 June 2026) and Beppu, scaled down for a small regional city. Tottori aggregator sites gave inconsistent numbers (an inexpensive meal of about $9, a mid-range dinner for two of about $31-34). I found no Tottori cappuccino price. Coffee is based on the Tokyo and Beppu cappuccino prices of about ¥484-534, set slightly lower. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass are estimated from the local relationship to beer, with a cocktail at about 1.4x a draft beer and a glass of wine at about 1.3x. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings. Tottori has few hostels, so those anchors are the least certain. Yen figures were converted at roughly ¥150-155 per USD.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other small regional Japanese cities such as Beppu, and a Tokyo-to-regional discount of roughly 10-25% on restaurant prices. Accommodation is based on typical business-hotel and guesthouse pricing in San'in prefectural capitals.
